353	def _validate_join_strategy(join_strategy: Any) -> str | None:
354	    """Validate the optional ``join_strategy`` argument.
355	
356	    Returns the canonical lowercase strategy name, or ``None`` when the
357	    caller did not request one.  Any other value (including a non-string)
358	    raises :class:`ValueError`; callers run this before opening any file.
359	    """
360	    if join_strategy is None:
361	        return None
362	    if not isinstance(join_strategy, str) or join_strategy not in _JOIN_STRATEGIES:
363	        allowed = ", ".join(sorted(_JOIN_STRATEGIES))
364	        raise ValueError(
365	            f"invalid join_strategy: {join_strategy!r}; expected one of {allowed}"
366	        )
367	    return join_strategy

383	@dataclass(frozen=True)
384	class _Token:
385	    kind: str  # one of: keyword, ident, number, string, op, star, eof
386	    value: Any
387	    text: str
388	
389	
390	_NUMBER_RE = re.compile(
391	    r"""
392	    \d+(?:\.\d*)?(?:[eE][+-]?\d+)?   # 1, 1., 1.5, 1e3, 1.5e-2
393	    | \.\d+(?:[eE][+-]?\d+)?         # .5
394	    """,
395	    re.VERBOSE,
396	)
397	# Bare identifiers: Unicode letters/underscore first, then word characters.
398	_IDENT_RE = re.compile(r"[^\W\d]\w*", re.UNICODE)
399	
400	
401	def _tokenize(sql: str) -> list[_Token]:
402	    if not isinstance(sql, str):
403	        raise QuerySyntaxError("SQL statement must be a string")
404	    tokens: list[_Token] = []
405	    i = 0
406	    n = len(sql)
407	    while i < n:
408	        ch = sql[i]
409	        if ch.isspace():
410	            i += 1
411	            continue
412	        if ch == "*":
413	            tokens.append(_Token("star", None, ch))
414	            i += 1
415	            continue
416	        if ch in ",()+-/":
417	            tokens.append(_Token("op", ch, ch))
418	            i += 1
419	            continue
420	        if ch in "=<>!":
421	            if ch == "!" and i + 1 < n and sql[i + 1] == "=":
422	                tokens.append(_Token("op", "!=", "!="))
423	                i += 2
424	                continue
425	            if ch in "<>" and i + 1 < n and sql[i + 1] == "=":
426	                op = ch + "="
427	                tokens.append(_Token("op", op, op))
428	                i += 2
429	                continue
430	            if ch in "=<>":
431	                tokens.append(_Token("op", ch, ch))
432	                i += 1
433	                continue
434	            raise QuerySyntaxError(f"unexpected character '!' at position {i}")
435	        if ch == "'":
436	            value, new_i = _tokenize_string(sql, i)
437	            tokens.append(_Token("string", value, sql[i:new_i]))
438	            i = new_i
439	            continue
440	        if ch == '"':
441	            value, new_i = _tokenize_quoted_ident(sql, i)
442	            tokens.append(_token_from_word(value, quoted=True))
443	            i = new_i
444	            continue
445	        if ch.isdigit() or ch == ".":
446	            match = _NUMBER_RE.match(sql, i)
447	            if match:
448	                text = match.group(0)
449	                tokens.append(_Token("number", _parse_number(text), text))
450	                i = match.end()
451	                continue
452	            # A '.' that does not start a number is the qualifier separator
453	            # used by multi-table queries ("table.column").
454	            tokens.append(_Token("op", ".", ch))
455	            i += 1
456	            continue
457	        match = _IDENT_RE.match(sql, i)
458	        if match:
459	            text = match.group(0)
460	            tokens.append(_token_from_word(text, quoted=False))
461	            i = match.end()
462	            continue
463	        raise QuerySyntaxError(f"unexpected character {ch!r} at position {i}")
464	    tokens.append(_Token("eof", None, ""))
465	    return tokens
466	
467	
468	def _token_from_word(word: str, *, quoted: bool) -> _Token:
469	    lowered = word.lower()
470	    if not quoted and lowered in _KEYWORDS:
471	        if lowered == "true":
472	            return _Token("number", True, word)
473	        if lowered == "false":
474	            return _Token("number", False, word)
475	        return _Token("keyword", lowered, word)
476	    return _Token("qident" if quoted else "ident", word, word)
477	
478	
479	def _tokenize_string(sql: str, start: int) -> tuple[str, int]:
480	    parts: list[str] = []
481	    i = start + 1
482	    n = len(sql)
483	    while True:
484	        j = sql.find("'", i)
485	        if j == -1:
486	            raise QuerySyntaxError("unterminated string literal")
487	        parts.append(sql[i:j])
488	        if j + 1 < n and sql[j + 1] == "'":
489	            parts.append("'")
490	            i = j + 2
491	            continue
492	        value = "".join(parts)
493	        try:
494	            value.encode("utf-8")
495	        except UnicodeEncodeError:
496	            raise QuerySyntaxError("string literal is not valid UTF-8") from None
497	        return value, j + 1
498	
499	
500	def _tokenize_quoted_ident(sql: str, start: int) -> tuple[str, int]:
501	    parts: list[str] = []
502	    i = start + 1
503	    n = len(sql)
504	    while True:
505	        j = sql.find('"', i)
506	        if j == -1:
507	            raise QuerySyntaxError("unterminated quoted identifier")
508	        parts.append(sql[i:j])
509	        if j + 1 < n and sql[j + 1] == '"':
510	            parts.append('"')
511	            i = j + 2
512	            continue
513	        value = "".join(parts)
514	        if not value:
515	            raise QuerySyntaxError("quoted identifier must not be empty")
516	        return value, j + 1
517	
518	
519	def _parse_number(text: str) -> int | float:
520	    try:
521	        if any(ch in text for ch in ".eE"):
522	            value: int | float = float(text)
523	        else:
524	            value = int(text, 10)
525	    except ValueError:
526	        raise QuerySyntaxError(f"invalid numeric literal {text!r}") from None
527	    if isinstance(value, int):
528	        # The magnitude 2**63 is accepted unsigned; the signed range check
529	        # happens after the optional leading sign is applied.
530	        if not (0 <= value <= 2**63):
531	            raise QuerySyntaxError(f"integer literal {text} is outside the int64 range")
532	        return value
533	    if not math.isfinite(value):
534	        raise QuerySyntaxError(f"float literal {text} must be finite")
535	    return value

539	# Parsed expression tree
540	#
541	# Node tuples:
542	#   ("literal", python_value, type_name)
543	#   ("column", name, table|None, table_quoted)        -- as parsed
544	#   ("column", name, index, type_name, nullable)      -- after binding
545	#   ("arith", op, left_node, right_node)              -- as parsed (+ - * /)
546	#   ("arith", op, left_node, right_node, type_name)   -- after binding
547	#   ("unary", operand, negate)                        -- as parsed
548	#   ("unary", operand, negate, type_name)             -- after binding
549	#   ("case", ((cond, result), ...), else_node|None)   -- as parsed
550	#   ("case", ((cond, result), ...), else_node|None, type_name) -- after binding
551	#   ("cmp", op, left_node, right_node)
552	#   ("isnull", operand, negate)
553	#   ("not", operand)
554	#   ("and"|"or", left, right)
555	# Predicate nodes are boolean-typed (three-valued at evaluation time);
556	# "literal"/"column"/"arith"/"unary" nodes are value nodes.
557	#
558	# Projection / ORDER BY reference items:
559	#   ("column_ref", name)                 -- a plain column name
560	#   ("agg", func_upper, arg_name|None)   -- an aggregate call; arg None = '*'
561	#   ("expr", alias)                      -- a computed scalar expression
562	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

569	    kind: str  # "star" | "column" | "agg" | "expr"
570	    name: str | None = None  # column name, or the AS alias for kind == "expr"
571	    func: str | None = None  # uppercase function name for kind == "agg"
572	    arg: str | None = None  # aggregate column argument; "" stands for '*'
573	    distinct: bool = False  # kind == "agg": DISTINCT before the argument
574	    expr: tuple | None = None  # parsed scalar expression for kind == "expr"
575	    descending: bool = False

577	    # Table qualifiers (multi-table queries only; None when unqualified):

602	    items: tuple[_RefItem, ...]  # projection; may be a single ("star",) item

618	    def star(self) -> bool:
619	        return len(self.items) == 1 and self.items[0].kind == "star"
620	
621	    @property
622	    def has_aggregate(self) -> bool:
623	        return any(item.kind == "agg" for item in self.items)
624	
625	    @property
626	    def is_aggregate_query(self) -> bool:
627	        return self.has_aggregate or self.group_by is not None or self.having is not None

633	    def __init__(self, tokens: list[_Token], allow_join: bool = False):
634	        self.tokens = tokens
635	        self.pos = 0
636	        # Multi-table statements (qualified names + join clauses) are only
637	        # enabled for query_files; single-file entry points keep rejecting
638	        # them as syntax errors.
639	        self._allow_join = allow_join

641	    def parse(self) -> _Select:
642	        select = self._parse_select()
643	        if self._peek().kind != "eof":
644	            tok = self._peek()
645	            raise QuerySyntaxError(f"unexpected trailing input {tok.text!r}")
646	        return select

648	    def _parse_select(self) -> _Select:
649	        self._expect_keyword("select")
650	        distinct = self._accept_keyword("distinct")
651	        items = tuple(self._parse_projection())
652	        self._expect_keyword("from")
653	        table_tok = self._expect_table_name()
654	        joins: tuple[_Join, ...] = ()
655	        if self._allow_join:
656	            joins = tuple(self._parse_join_clauses())
657	        where = None
658	        if self._accept_keyword("where"):
659	            where = self._parse_or()
660	        group_by = None
661	        if self._accept_keyword("group"):
662	            self._expect_keyword("by")
663	            names = [self._parse_group_name()]
664	            while self._accept_op(","):
665	                names.append(self._parse_group_name())
666	            group_by = tuple(names)
667	        having = None
668	        if self._accept_keyword("having"):
669	            having = self._parse_having_or()
670	        order_by = None
671	        if self._accept_keyword("order"):
672	            self._expect_keyword("by")
673	            order_items = [self._parse_order_item()]
674	            while self._accept_op(","):
675	                order_items.append(self._parse_order_item())
676	            order_by = tuple(order_items)
677	        limit = None
678	        if self._accept_keyword("limit"):
679	            limit = self._parse_limit()
680	        return _Select(
681	            items=items,
682	            table=table_tok.value,
683	            table_quoted=table_tok.kind == "qident",
684	            where=where,
685	            group_by=group_by,
686	            having=having,
687	            order_by=order_by,
688	            limit=limit,
689	            joins=joins,
690	            distinct=distinct,
691	        )

693	    def _parse_join_clauses(self) -> list[_Join]:
694	        # Zero or more join clauses may follow FROM; each introduces exactly
695	        # one new table with a single equi-ON condition.  "right" / "full" /
696	        # "outer" stay ordinary identifiers away from this clause (they are
697	        # matched with _accept_word), so columns carrying those names keep
698	        # working outside join parsing.
699	        joins: list[_Join] = []
700	        while True:
701	            if self._accept_keyword("inner"):
702	                self._expect_keyword("join")
703	                joins.append(self._parse_join("inner"))
704	            elif self._accept_keyword("left"):
705	                self._expect_keyword("join")
706	                joins.append(self._parse_join("left"))
707	            elif self._accept_word("right"):
708	                self._expect_keyword("join")
709	                joins.append(self._parse_join("right"))
710	            elif self._accept_word("full"):
711	                # Only the explicit FULL OUTER JOIN spelling is accepted.
712	                self._expect_word("outer")
713	                self._expect_keyword("join")
714	                joins.append(self._parse_join("full"))
715	            else:
716	                return joins

722	        self._expect_op("=")
723	        right_key = self._parse_on_key()

725	            kind=kind,
726	            table=table_tok.value,
727	            table_quoted=table_tok.kind == "qident",
728	            left_key=left_key,
729	            right_key=right_key,

732	    def _parse_on_key(self) -> tuple:
733	        tok = self._peek()

735	            raise QuerySyntaxError(
736	                f"ON requires table-qualified columns, got {tok.text!r}"
737	            )

751	    def _parse_projection(self) -> list[_RefItem]:
752	        items = [self._parse_select_item()]
753	        while self._accept_op(","):
754	            items.append(self._parse_select_item())
755	        # Aliases are only supported for computed scalar expressions (which
756	        # consume their own "AS alias" in _parse_select_item); a trailing
757	        # identifier (including the spelling "as") where FROM is expected
758	        # names one on a bare column or aggregate.  Plain queries keep their
759	        # historical QuerySyntaxError classification; aggregate queries treat
760	        # the unsupported alias as a validation error.
761	        tok = self._peek()
762	        if tok.kind in ("ident", "qident") or (
763	            tok.kind == "keyword" and tok.value == "as"
764	        ):
765	            grouped_ahead = any(
766	                t.kind == "keyword" and t.value == "group"
767	                for t in self.tokens[self.pos :]
768	            )
769	            if any(item.kind == "agg" for item in items) or grouped_ahead:
770	                raise QueryValidationError(
771	                    f"aliases are not supported; unexpected {tok.text!r} after projection item"
772	                )
773	            raise QuerySyntaxError(f"expected FROM, got {tok.text!r}")
774	        return items

776	    def _parse_select_item(self) -> _RefItem:
777	        tok = self._peek()
778	        if tok.kind == "star":
779	            self._next()
780	            return _RefItem("star")
781	        if (
782	            tok.kind == "ident"
783	            and tok.value.lower() in _AGG_NAMES
784	            and self.tokens[self.pos + 1].kind == "op"
785	            and self.tokens[self.pos + 1].value == "("
786	        ):
787	            item = self._parse_column_or_agg()
788	            if self._arith_op_ahead():
789	                raise QueryValidationError(
790	                    "aggregate calls cannot be combined with scalar arithmetic"
791	                )
792	            return item
793	        node = self._parse_arith()
794	        if node[0] == "column":
795	            # A bare (possibly parenthesised) column reference keeps its
796	            # existing projection behaviour and needs no alias.
797	            return _RefItem(
798	                "column", name=node[1], table=node[2], table_quoted=node[3]
799	            )
800	        # A computed scalar expression must be named with AS.
801	        self._expect_keyword("as")
802	        alias = self._peek()
803	        if alias.kind not in ("ident", "qident"):
804	            raise QuerySyntaxError(
805	                f"AS requires a result name, got {alias.text!r}"
806	            )
807	        self._next()
808	        return _RefItem("expr", name=alias.value, expr=node)

811	        tok = self._peek()

813	            tok.kind == "op" and tok.value in ("+", "-", "/")

869	    def _parse_column_or_agg(self) -> _RefItem:
870	        tok = self._peek()
871	        if tok.kind not in ("ident", "qident"):
872	            raise QuerySyntaxError(f"expected identifier, got {tok.text!r}")
873	        if self._allow_join and self._qualifier_ahead():
874	            return self._parse_qualified_column()

876	        # can only be a plain column reference.
877	        if tok.kind == "qident" or tok.value.lower() not in _AGG_NAMES:
878	            self._next()
879	            return _RefItem("column", name=tok.value)

881	        self._next()  # consume the function name
882	        if not self._accept_op("("):

884	            # already consumed, so it is a plain column reference.
885	            return _RefItem("column", name=tok.value)
886	        arg, arg_table, arg_table_quoted, distinct = self._parse_aggregate_args(func)
887	        self._expect_op(")")
888	        return _RefItem(
889	            "agg",
890	            func=func.upper(),
891	            arg=arg,
892	            distinct=distinct,
893	            arg_table=arg_table,
894	            arg_table_quoted=arg_table_quoted,
895	        )

897	    def _parse_aggregate_args(self, func: str) -> tuple:
898	        # Exactly one argument: '*' for COUNT, otherwise one (possibly
899	        # table-qualified) identifier, optionally preceded by DISTINCT.
900	        # Returns (name, table, table_quoted, distinct); name "" stands
901	        # for '*'.  DISTINCT only deduplicates the argument values of this
902	        # call; it accepts a single column reference only, and any other
903	        # use (a star, a missing argument, an expression, extra arguments
904	        # or a nested call) is a syntax error raised before any file is
905	        # opened.
906	        tok = self._peek()
907	        if tok.kind == "keyword" and tok.value == "case":
908	            raise QueryValidationError(
909	                f"{func.upper()} argument must be a column reference, not a CASE expression"
910	            )
911	        if tok.kind == "keyword" and tok.value == "distinct":
912	            self._next()
913	            tok = self._peek()
914	            if tok.kind == "star":
915	                raise QuerySyntaxError(
916	                    f"{func.upper()}(DISTINCT ...) does not accept '*'"
917	                )
918	            if tok.kind not in ("ident", "qident"):
919	                raise QuerySyntaxError(
920	                    f"{func.upper()}(DISTINCT ...) requires one column argument, "
921	                    f"got {tok.text!r}"
922	                )
923	            if self._allow_join and self._qualifier_ahead():
924	                item = self._parse_qualified_column()
925	                name, table, table_quoted = item.name, item.table, item.table_quoted
926	            else:
927	                self._next()
928	                name, table, table_quoted = tok.value, None, False
929	            nxt = self._peek()
930	            if nxt.kind == "op" and nxt.value == "(":
931	                raise QuerySyntaxError(
932	                    f"{func.upper()}(DISTINCT ...) argument must be a column name, "
933	                    "not a function call"
934	                )
935	            if self._arith_op_ahead():
936	                raise QuerySyntaxError(
937	                    f"{func.upper()}(DISTINCT ...) argument must be a column "
938	                    "reference, not an expression"
939	                )
940	            return (name, table, table_quoted, True)
941	        if tok.kind == "star":
942	            if func != "count":
943	                raise QuerySyntaxError(f"{func.upper()} does not accept '*'")
944	            self._next()
945	            return ("", None, False, False)
946	        if tok.kind not in ("ident", "qident"):
947	            raise QuerySyntaxError(
948	                f"{func.upper()} requires one column argument, got {tok.text!r}"
949	            )
950	        if self._allow_join and self._qualifier_ahead():
951	            item = self._parse_qualified_column()
952	            nxt = self._peek()
953	            if nxt.kind == "op" and nxt.value == "(":
954	                raise QuerySyntaxError(
955	                    f"{func.upper()} argument must be a column name, not a function call"
956	                )
957	            self._reject_expression_in_agg_arg(func)
958	            return (item.name, item.table, item.table_quoted, False)
959	        self._next()
960	        nxt = self._peek()
961	        if nxt.kind == "op" and nxt.value == "(":
962	            if tok.kind == "ident" and tok.value.lower() in _AGG_NAMES:
963	                raise QueryValidationError(
964	                    f"aggregate functions must not be nested: "
965	                    f"{func.upper()}({tok.value.upper()}(...))"
966	                )
967	            raise QuerySyntaxError(
968	                f"{func.upper()} argument must be a column name, not a function call"
969	            )
970	        self._reject_expression_in_agg_arg(func)
971	        return (tok.value, None, False, False)

1027	    # HAVING shares the WHERE boolean structure (NOT / AND / OR / comparison /

1046	        tok = self._peek()

1194	    # Arithmetic expressions (numeric scalar operands) ------------------------

1207	    def _parse_term(self) -> tuple:

1213	                node = ("arith", "*", node, self._parse_factor())

1220	    def _parse_factor(self) -> tuple:

1229	                # (-9223372036854775808 is valid, the bare magnitude is not).

1300	    def _parse_case(self) -> tuple:
1301	        # A searched CASE: at least one "WHEN cond THEN result", an optional
1302	        # "ELSE result", terminated by END.  Conditions are boolean
1303	        # expressions; results are scalar (numeric, bool or utf8) and may
1304	        # themselves contain nested CASE expressions.  The simple form
1305	        # (CASE value WHEN ...) is not supported.
1306	        branches: list[tuple] = []
1307	        while True:
1308	            self._expect_keyword("when")
1309	            condition = self._parse_or()
1310	            self._expect_keyword("then")
1311	            result = self._parse_arith()
1312	            branches.append((condition, result))
1313	            tok = self._peek()
1314	            if not (tok.kind == "keyword" and tok.value == "when"):

1317	        if self._accept_keyword("else"):

1326	
1327	    def _next(self) -> _Token:
1328	        tok = self.tokens[self.pos]
1329	        self.pos += 1
1330	        return tok

1332	    def _accept(self, kind: str) -> bool:

1334	            self.pos += 1
1335	            return True

1338	    def _accept_op(self, value: str) -> bool:
1339	        tok = self._peek()
1340	        if tok.kind == "op" and tok.value == value:
1341	            self.pos += 1
1342	            return True
1343	        return False
1344	
1345	    def _accept_keyword(self, value: str) -> bool:
1346	        tok = self._peek()
1347	        if tok.kind == "keyword" and tok.value == value:

1370	        if tok.kind != "keyword" or tok.value != value:
1371	            raise QuerySyntaxError(f"expected {value.upper()}, got {tok.text!r}")
1372	        return self._next()

1375	        tok = self._peek()
1376	        if tok.kind != "op" or tok.value != value:
1377	            raise QuerySyntaxError(f"expected {value!r}, got {tok.text!r}")
